what: Order Items 1256 and 1257 moved to the site recycle bin (recycle(), restorable for 93 days) on 2026-09-28 ~10:38 at the user's request. Both were empty rows created by accident in grid-editing view: no Title, order, model, client, location or qty, never edited since creation (version 1.0). Only column defaults (ItemStatus Active, Frame Plaspak) and calculated columns (FxYear/FxRate/PriceCAD = error;#256) were set. The empty-check ran immediately before recycling, in the user's browser console (fallback: the automated browser tab was frozen under memory pressure).
restore: Site contents > Recycle bin > the Order Items items (GUIDs below) > Restore. Or REST: POST _api/web/RecycleBin('<recycleBinId>')/restore().
